text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PDINC-38421 fired -> alert: `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` spike on pool `dedicated-gpu-pool-03` (region: us-west2). metric: gpu_mem_alloc_fail_rate > 5% over 1m. affected model: redwood-v2-large (single-req mode). auto-evictor triggered 3x.

pagerduty: PDINC-38421 acknowledged by Aisha (oncall) at 2026-03-14T10:12:04Z. escalation policy: oncall-sre -> sre-lead.

Aisha (oncall): acked. I'm pulling logs and checking which nodes are hot. tagging @Marco.

Marco (SRE): on it. quick look: nvlink memory fragmentation + sustained KV cache growth from `tensor-slicer` jobs. suspect leaking sessions not releasing KV cache.

Devon: seeing similar on dashboards — pool slot 7/16 showing repeated cuda alloc fail counts. latency for redwood-v2-large jumped to 1200ms p95, error rate ~12% for that model route.

Aisha (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) temporarily scale down concurrency for redwood-v2-large on this pool, 2) failover heavy customers to quantized-v2-medium, 3) cordon the 2 worst nodes and restart the worker agent. Doing #1 now via redwoodctl.

Katrina: please post the commands you'll run so devs can reproduce.

Aisha (oncall): commands I'm running:```bash
# reduce max_batch_size for the model route
redwoodctl route update --route /v1/generation --model redwood-v2-large --param max_batch_size=1 --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-03

# cordon & drain node-7
kubectl cordon node-7
redwoodctl node evict node-7 --grace-period 30s

# quick status check
redwoodctl pool describe dedicated-gpu-pool-03 --json | jq '.nodes[] | {name, gpu_mem_used, alloc_fail_count}'
```

Marco (SRE): good. I'll trigger a rolling-restart on node-7 after drain if it doesn't release KV cache. if restart fails, we'll drain the whole pool and move traffic.

Devon: I pushed a temporary routing rule to redirect 20% traffic to quantized-v2-medium in us-west2 to reduce pressure. Monitoring error rate now.

incident-bot: Note: auto-shedder has already started rejecting large batched requests to maintain latency SLOs. Rejections at 10:14:09Z.

Aisha (oncall): Customer impact: approximate 3% of active customers saw 5xx on the generation endpoint (time window 10:11–10:20). Two customers (acct: acme-corp, acct: searchly) reported request timeouts — we've contacted support and opened a high-priority ticket.

Katrina: any indication of regression from last deploy?

Marco (SRE): checked release graph — no new deploys to the pool in last 6 hours. this looks like steady-state leak + cache thrash. logs show repeated `kv_cache_put` without corresponding `kv_cache_release`.

Devon: I gathered a heap of `nvidia-smi` outputs and attached to the incident record: `/var/log/pool-03/gpu-usage-10-11.tgz`. also grabbing `redwood-agent` debug logs.

Aisha (oncall): escalation: PagerDuty policy will auto-escalate in 8 minutes if not resolved. tagging @Marco for handoff when I finish restart of node-7.

pagerduty: PDINC-38421: Aisha (oncall) acknowledged. escalation timer paused.

Marco (SRE): node-7 restart completed at 10:18:32Z. KV cache freed, alloc-fail-rate dropped to 0.9% on that node. continuing to monitor pool.

Aisha (oncall): rolling-restart node-11 next, but will keep traffic diversion until metrics stabilize.

Devon: after node-7 restart + 20% diversion, p95 latency down to 430ms and error rate back to 1.2%. looks good so far.

Katrina: any follow-ups for postmortem?

Marco (SRE): action items: 1) add guard to kv_cache to drop entries older than 10m, 2) improve agent metric for outstanding kv_handles, 3) add automated detection for leak pattern and preemptively cordon nodes. I'll own 1 & 2.

Aisha (oncall): I'll update the incident record with customer-notifications and confirm support tickets. leaving the thread open for 30m for monitoring. handoff to Marco if anything regresses.

incident-bot: PDINC-38421 status: acknowledged -> stable (monitoring). auto-escalation timer cleared.

Marco (SRE): marking this as mitigated for now. will start a short RCA doc and link here when ready.

Devon: logs + artifacts collected under internal incident PDINC-38421: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PDINC-38421 (private).

Aisha (oncall): thanks team. I'll close the page if metrics remain healthy by 10:42Z. :thumbsup:
